verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an observability platform that ships monitors and automated workflows, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents version history, change review, or rollback for any Datadog automation. The Audit Trail and Monitors items are bare titles that describe no versioning or rollback capability, and the probes for the API, MCP server, and CLI say nothing about this either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
